intent.proves: Dynamic workspaces: empty-workspaces satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(s.DynamicStructureTitle AS nvarchar(200)) FROM DynamicStructures s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DynamicStructureLevels l WHERE l.DynamicStructureLevelStructureId = CAST(s.DynamicStructureUniqueId AS nvarchar(50)))
